name: Rosalind Franklin
summary: Rosalind Franklin produced crucial experimental work that helped reveal the structure of DNA.

facts.text: Franklin's x-ray diffraction image known as Photo 51 provided important evidence for DNA's helical structure.
facts.context: Her contribution reminds learners that careful experimental evidence can shape breakthroughs even when recognition is delayed.
facts.sourceTitle: Nature Education: Rosalind Franklin and Photo 51
